fullPassage: For millions of years, sea turtles would come to the beaches of Florida to spawn and their hatchlings would head toward the sea — to live a life far away — and to return to Florida years later. It turns out that the way the young turtles knew to head toward the direction of the ocean was based on light glimmering off the sea at night. The sea beautifully reflects the light of the moon and the stars, and for millions of years, a simple algorithm of "head toward the light at night" allowed the turtles to effectively head toward the sea to pursue an effective life strategy. Well, then came Miami. Miami and the other big cities on the coast of Florida are filled with lots of bright lights at night, so this led to an ecological disaster for the sea turtles. Shaped by evolution to head toward light at night, hatchlings started toward the highways and cities by the millions — meeting premature death instead of a long sea-dwelling life.

det.korean: 물고기·거북 등이 물속에 알을 낳다
det.analysis:
❌ ① hatch(부화하다): 알에서 새끼가 나오는 것, 알을 낳는 것이 아님
❌ ② migrate(이주하다): 서식지를 옮기는 것
❌ ③ nest(둥지를 틀다): 둥지를 짓는 행위
✅ ④ spawn(산란하다): 물속에 알을 낳다=정의와 일치 ← 정답
det.tip: spawn=산란하다. 부화(hatch)와 구별

questions.passage: The sea beautifully reflects the light of the moon and the stars, and for millions of years, a simple algorithm of "head toward the light at night" allowed the turtles to __________ (effective) head toward the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: effective → effectively: 동사 head를 수식하는 부사 형태
det.analysis: effective(형용사) → effectively(부사). 동사 head(향하다)를 수식하려면 부사가 필요. 형용사 + -ly = 부사
det.tip: effectively=효과적으로(형용사 effective + -ly)

questions.passage: __________ (Shape) by evolution to head toward light at night, hatchlings started toward the highways and cities by the millions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: Shape → Shaped: 분사구문의 수동(과거분사) 형태
det.analysis: Shape(동사) → Shaped(과거분사). 새끼들이 진화에 의해 '형성된' 것이므로 수동 의미의 분사구문. Being이 생략된 수동 분사구문 = 과거분사로 시작
det.tip: 분사구문 수동: (Being) Shaped by~=~에 의해 형성되어

questions.passage: For millions of years, sea turtles would come to the beaches of Florida to spawn and their hatchlings would head toward the sea — to live a life far away — and to return to Florida years later. It turns out that the way the young turtles knew to head toward the direction of the ocean was __________ light glimmering off the sea at night. The sea beautifully reflects the light of the moon and the stars, and for millions of years, a simple algorithm of "head toward the light at night" allowed the turtles to effectively head toward the sea to pursue an effective life strategy. Well, then came Miami. Miami and the other big cities on the coast of Florida are filled with lots of bright lights at night, so this led to an ecological disaster for the sea turtles. Shaped by evolution to head toward light at night, hatchlings started toward the highways and cities by the millions — meeting premature death instead of a long sea-dwelling life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 어린 거북이 바다 방향을 아는 방식은 밤에 반짝이는 빛에 ______ 있었다
det.analysis:
✅ ① based on(~에 기반한): 방향 감각이 빛에 '근거'함 ← 정답
❌ ② aimed at(~을 겨냥한): 목적을 나타내 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ opposed to(~에 반대되는): 반대 의미로 모순
❌ ④ separate from(~와 분리된): 빛에 근거한다는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: be based on~=~에 기반하다/근거하다

questions.passage: For millions of years, sea turtles would come to the beaches of Florida to spawn and their hatchlings would head toward the sea — to __________ — and to return to Florida years later. It turns out that the way the young turtles knew to head toward the direction of the ocean was based on light glimmering off the sea at night. The sea beautifully reflects the light of the moon and the stars, and for millions of years, a simple algorithm of "head toward the light at night" allowed the turtles to effectively head toward the sea to pursue an effective life strategy. Well, then came Miami. Miami and the other big cities on the coast of Florida are filled with lots of bright lights at night, so this led to an ecological disaster for the sea turtles. Shaped by evolution to head toward light at night, hatchlings started toward the highways and cities by the millions — meeting premature death instead of a long sea-dwelling life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 새끼들은 바다로 향해 ______ 그러다 수년 후 플로리다로 돌아온다
det.analysis:
❌ ① stay near the busy shore(붐비는 해안 근처에 머물다): '멀리'가 아닌 근처는 return years later와 모순
✅ ② live a life far away(멀리서 삶을 살다): 바다로 나가 멀리 살다가 수년 후 돌아온다는 흐름 ← 정답
❌ ③ hide beneath the bright lights(밝은 불빛 아래 숨다): 밝은 불빛은 후반부 도시 재앙 내용
❌ ④ feed along the sandy coast(모래 해안을 따라 먹이를 먹다): 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: head toward the sea → live a life far away → return years later 흐름
